_comment: The SHAPE v6 — the couplet, in order, vosk-verified, narrator line moved out. Suspense says TOUGH TIME NEVER LASTS; the payoff ONLY TOUGH PEOPLE LAST lands on the first bar of DROP 1 (stab holds back until the payoff has spoken); resay says the setup again; DROP 2 answers with the solo. One voice at a time everywhere. The deadpan closing line 'He's wrong of course…' now lives in id/intermezzo-1/ (the doorframe into theGodInUrhead), so THE WARD AHEAD is purely instrumental — its D-minor gauze hands straight to the intermezzo, which holds the line over that same gauze. demi_demi is now a pure crate jam (all vocals are samples).

sections.label: THE DOOR — tough times, walk in
intro — four-on-the-floor, acid born dull, the call murmurs
the roll — bed steps out, bass clone joins
the invocation — his gibberish sounds, speaking in tongues before the prophecy
the build — filter opening, riser under
the prior line — the '…right now' mumble, light pulse
TOUGH TIME NEVER LASTS — beat out, riser cresting
…ONLY TOUGH PEOPLE LAST — alone in the silence…
THE DROP — immediately, demistab punches the 4s
the resay — TOUGH TIME NEVER LASTS over thinned beat
the juggle nod — gibberish slices, brief, alone
THE WARD AHEAD — the rave dims to gauze, the door swings open
